lines.text: Friend of me? Say of mine!
Many learners say: He is a friend of me.
Better: He is a friend of mine.
Mine! She is a friend of mine.

data.wrong: He is a friend of me.
data.right: He is a friend of mine.

native.tip: نقول بالعربية «صديق لي»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول a friend of mine: “He is a friend of mine.” وليس “He is a friend of me.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “He is a friend of me.” 😅 نقول بالعربية «صديق لي»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول a friend of mine، فالجملة الصحيحة “He is a friend of mine.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “mine” — نقول بالعربية «صديق لي»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول a friend of mine. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we say «صديق لي», but in English we say a friend of mine: “He is a friend of mine.” not “He is a friend of me.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “He is a friend of me.” 😅 In Arabic we say «صديق لي», but in English we say a friend of mine, so the right sentence is “He is a friend of mine.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
